resources.string: LastScroll observes tap and scroll events, app window changes, and volume key presses, only within the apps you select and only while a sleep timer is running. It uses them only to reset or pause the sleep timer, and to go home and lock the screen when the timer expires. Nothing is stored or transmitted.

LastScroll uses the Accessibility API to observe tap and scroll events, app window changes, and volume key presses, only within the apps you select and only while a sleep timer is running.

This is used only to reset the sleep timer while you are active, pause it when you leave those apps, and turn the screen off when it expires.

Nothing is stored or transmitted.
If the app was sideloaded on Android 13 or later, first open App info, tap the menu, and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
Activity in the selected apps resets the timer
